backend/main.mo: Actor storing per-user submission histories with functions to add, retrieve, query by timestamp, clear, and list users.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to involved files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries for all frontend source files and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styles defining color tokens, themes, and base UI variables.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point referencing favicon, metadata, and bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing global providers and switching between landing, generate, and history views.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: App layout wrapper with top navigation, content slot, and footer branding.
frontend/src/components/HiddenVariations: Displays hidden image variations with restore and regenerate controls.
frontend/src/components/HistoryDetail.ts: Detailed history entry view showing original image, timestamp, and all generated variations.
Image upload component handling validation, preview generation, and metadata extraction.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: A top navigation bar component with buttons to switch between landing, generate, and history views.
frontend/src/components/VariationGrid.ts: Displays a grid of image variations with preview, download, and hide actions, plus a viewer dialog trigger.
frontend/src/components/VariationViewerD: A dialog that shows a larger preview of a variation and provides a download button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and helpers for Internet Identity login, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating submission history through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus custom neon-themed variables and utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/historyStorage.ts: LocalStorage helpers for saving, loading, and clearing image variation history.
frontend/src/lib/imageMeta.ts: Loads an image file to extract width, height, and file size metadata.
frontend/src/lib/onDeviceVariations.ts: Generates on-device image variations by applying preset-based canvas effects to an image.
frontend/src/lib/variationPresets.ts: Defines variation preset interface, a list of style presets, and a helper to select random presets.
frontend/src/lib/variationState.ts: Defines the VariationItem type for storing generated variation metadata.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Sets up React app root with React Query and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/History.tsx: Implements history view with list display, detail view, and ability to clear saved history.
frontend/src/pages/LandingIntro.tsx: Displays the branded landing intro with hero image, manifesto text, and a start button.
frontend/src/pages/UploadAndGenerate.tsx: Handles image upload, variation generation, hiding/restoring items, and regeneration workflow.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, shadows, animations, and typography plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project state, requirements, existing features, and branding image needs.
